About LV Tour & Travels

Your trusted travel partner from Bangalore and Mysore, since 2026

OUR STORY

Travel made simple, comfortable and memorable

LV Tour & Travels began in 2026 in Bangalore and Mysore with a simple idea: planning a trip should feel as good as taking it. We plan trips for families, friends, couples and corporate groups, from a quick weekend in Coorg to a long holiday across India.

We look after the transport, the stays and the sightseeing, so you can spend your time on the people you are travelling with. Tell us your budget, days and interests, and we will shape the plan around you.

Based in Bangalore and Mysore. Pickup is available from both cities.

How We Plan Your Trip
